name: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic
description: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic is a singleplayer third-person role-playing game and the first in the Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic series.

optional_settings.title: Raise anti-aliasing and anisotropic filtering
optional_settings.reason: The game's graphics options default to no anti-aliasing and no anisotropic filtering. This sets 8x anti-aliasing and 16x anisotropic filtering for sharper edges and textures.
